boundary_decision.rationale: The engineering BOM revision owns a coherent occurrence graph and controlled applicability. Product types, design, configured variants and installed items retain independent masters; frozen COMPOSE WM-OBJ-002 is preserved.

decisions.rationale: Stable occurrence bindings remain distinct from product-type identity, displayed item numbers, merged rows and physical serial items.
Parent base quantity, units, overrides, unknowns and exclusions are explicit. Alternate candidates are not counted as installed; substitution is directional and evidence-qualified.
Family graph and selected effective graph differ. Traversal stops with explicit incompleteness; process recursion is not physical self-containment or an implemented recursion solver.
Nominal design references, recognition uncertainty and functional contributions do not establish actual assembly condition, hardness, safe actuation or certification.
Controlled revisions, expected-base checks, where-used scope, withheld branches and retention preserve authority and provenance. Actual permission policy must be instantiated.

Selected vendor docs and public ISO scope motivate proposals, not normative field compliance. SAP indexed text, unread licensed clauses, nested schema, adapters and real fixtures remain explicit holds.

deferred_research: Executable field-level schemas and negative fixtures for units, cycles, alternatives and concurrent revisions.

publication_holds: No independent external research or reviewer: Claude and Grok each have one terminal timeout. Codex research and a separate no-tools self-check remain reviewable-draft, never canonical.

Physical properties and capabilities require component/design evidence; model validity is not assembly certification or physical-action authority.
Adopters must configure actual owner/delegation, access, retention, applicability predicates and acceptance criteria.
